public.text: Stable standards-based interfaces are appropriate, but the requirement does not address versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation, event interfaces, bulk exchange, or offline distribution.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the criterion to require versioned interfaces, compatibility policies, published deprecation periods, standard query and event patterns, machine-readable specifications, and appropriate bulk or offline access mechanisms.
